summary: FirstCash Holdings (through subsidiary Chess Bidco) announced a recommended cash acquisition of Ramsdens Holdings PLC via a court-sanctioned scheme of arrangement under UK law. Ramsdens shareholders will receive 609 pence per share (600 pence from Bidco plus a 9 pence permitted dividend). The deal requires approval from a majority in number and 75% of voting Ramsdens shareholders, High Court sanction, and FCA regulatory clearance. The board of Ramsdens has recommended the offer. Closing is expected after conditions are met; watch for shareholder vote and regulatory timeline to assess risk-arb spread.
